Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - FIR No. 230/2023

Dear Ms. Hegde,

Thank you for meeting us on 23 November 2023 about your dispute with Arjun Swamy. As we understand it, the complaint was filed during a matrimonial dispute.

Our advice is to seek interim protection and offer to attend mediation. Please collect the marriage certificate and messages showing attempts to settle and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
